title: Experiment support and verification: canonical checklist and gradual backfill
summary: The user requested consolidated terminology, an explicit canonical list and gradual completion/backfill. The first pass enumerates all 38 experiments in seven group-owned methods lists and separates implementation support from scoped verification evidence. No new trial or blanket reproducibility claim.
decision_provenance: User: consolidate the stages/steps, make the list explicit and canonical, and gradually complete/backfill it. Assistant: use independent operation capabilities and scoped verification, not a single maturity ladder; propose first reusable scopes without claiming user selection of those studies.
reopen_when: A selected reuse requires a historical method, inputs are recovered, a maintained operation changes, or a new scoped verification receipt becomes available.
